## None of it comes apart

- I started `epinowcast` in 2021 to be the modular one. It still cannot
  be taken apart into pieces anyone else can use
- The same structural request has been written down in `EpiNow2` four
  times since 2020. Two were closed as done and left the package no
  easier to take apart. Two are still open
- We wrote down a [workflow for building these models][wf2], then could
  not follow it with the tools we had built

::: {.attribution}
